title: Finch Circle Loyalty Program — Spend Bonus on Registry Price Protection (Merchandise Purchases)
content:
A registrant claiming registry price protection on a Merchandise Purchases unit whose Finch Circle qualifying spend posted in the twelve calendar months before the request date (purchase earn entries whose posting date falls less than twelve whole months before it) reaches the upper protection spend threshold of $2500.00 receives the upper protection spend bonus of $8.00; one whose such spend reaches the middle protection spend threshold of $1000.00 but not the upper receives the middle protection spend bonus of $4.00.

## Basis Q&A

**Which spend is counted?** The qualifying amount of the purchase earn entries in the registrant's Finch Circle Loyalty Program points ledger, for entries posted less than twelve whole months before the request date.

**What does a registrant with exactly $2500.00 of such spend receive?** $8.00 — the upper threshold is reached at $2500.00.

**And with $2499.99?** $4.00 — the middle threshold of $1000.00 is reached, the upper is not.

**And with exactly $1000.00?** $4.00.

**And with $999.99?** Neither threshold is reached; the registrant is outside this rule.
